subject: It was the greatest show on earth
author: SUFFUR
body:
It was like the moon landings of the Burnout World (Maybe update Frank Zappa, 2009 July 16, we could also fly to the moon, lol)

Now if they could help us understand how handling of cars works, so I can learn to drive,in Paradise lol.

But a bike that is fast with no boost is good, they haz fast acc. and a good top speed, so no boost is needed.

Mid Air races with Blimps in the air, to race round sounds good, also to scout out new race routes, and mid air take downs?

And talk of the Island, thought they were doing a few Islands, like Race Island, Off Road Island etc?

Anyway it was a good show and we will see if they can put it together, as a download video, with edited  footage from the game play from the TV, showing what was happening at the begining, and Hi-Res stuff of the Bike, Plane, etc and Night time, which was great stuff, fingers crossed for Bad weather, lol.

Also noticed the Criterion Web site is getting a lot of hits, that I can't add a thing, lol. Server update for the web now, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
